deterministic_blocker.impact: The strict preflight can return PREFLIGHT_VERIFIED while the GPU runtime executes local staged Python bytes whose size and SHA-256 were never pinned by the manifest. This violates the requested complete parent import closure and makes source identity incomplete.

required_remediation: Publish a new immutable release whose staged models package initializer does not import unneeded unmanifested modules, or add every runtime-reachable local staged source to the manifest with exact size and SHA-256.
Add a regression that resolves the fresh-process package-parent import closure for models.birwkv7_diffusion and fails on any unmanifested local source.
Repeat this focused independent preflight against the new manifest before any live request.
